_comment: FeedClean selectors: the ONLY place TikTok strings, content-descs, and view IDs live. Each key is an ordered list of strategies (first match wins; the matched one is shown on the Debug screen) or a list of labels. Prefer content-desc/text, then semantic view IDs; obfuscated IDs (ibp, b9d, t92, …) are hints only. Keys starting with '_' are comments. Strategies marked "unverified": true are placeholders not yet seen in a device capture. 'topFraction': the node must lie in that top fraction of the TikTok window (a position modifier, never a predicate on its own). Source: scrubbed uiautomator fixtures under app/src/test/resources/fixtures/tiktok-47.7.3/ and tiktok-47.9.3/. Obfuscated IDs shift every release (47.7.3 -> 47.9.3: profile handle tei -> tmm, outer pager class X.06v5 -> X.04OY), so they only ever come AFTER a semantic strategy.

en._comment_feed: Feed video page. Only nodes inside the visible pager page are searched; the pre-loaded next page is ignored.

feed.avatar.note: When the creator is LIVE the avatar has no desc and opens the LIVE room; use the display name instead.

feed.probableHandle.note: Heuristic. Confirm on the profile or in the block dialog.

feed.sound.note: 47.9.3 search-results player (id/pya): 'Original sound by <name>', no handle in it.

en._comment_feedContext: FeedContext of every feed page (videos and LIVE previews), decided from the screen chrome ONLY: nodes outside the feed pager, so nothing a video shows counts. 1) feed.forYouTab matches -> FOR_YOU; 2) else feed.homeTopTabs (Home tab row) -> HOME_OTHER_TAB (Following, the location tab, ...); 3) else feed.searchPlayerBar -> SEARCH; 4) else OTHER (profile videos, hashtag/sound pages). Decided by WHICH tab is selected, never by tab order or the 'Shop' tab (desc-only in 47.7.3, text between Following and For You in 47.9.3). For You pages also carry a 'Search · <suggestion>' bar (ImageView desc 'Search' + TextView) INSIDE the page near the bottom: it is outside the chrome and below topFraction, so it never makes a page SEARCH.

feed.homeTopTabs.note: Tab label (android:id/text1). Present whichever tab is selected.
Tab container desc (47.7.3). The profile's 'Following' count label (td1) has no desc and sits lower.

en._comment_searchPlayerBar: Search-results video player (captured 47.9.3, m_search_player, 2026-11-25): same pager/page/rail as For You, no Home tabs, and a TOP search bar outside the pager: back arrow, query box (ImageView desc 'Search' + id/tv_search_sug_word = the query, never read or logged) and Button id/tv_bar_search 'Search'. Only the top fifth of the window counts.

feed.searchPlayerBar.note: The query text. Matched for presence only; never read or logged.
Query-box magnifier. Weakest: only reached when no Home tab matched.

en._comment_disclosure: One disclosure-label slot (id/ibp in 47.7.3). Its TEXT says what the post is, so the label texts match first and the obfuscated ID is the last-resort hint (a reassigned ID must never shadow the text strategies). Never looks at the display name or caption.

feed.disclosureLabel.note: 47.7.3 obfuscated ID; hint only. Surfaces label texts not in the lists on the Debug screen.

en._comment_corroborating: Corroborating paid-ad evidence only. Never sets isPaidAd on its own.
en._comment_anchor: Anchor row above the display name (id/feed_multi_tag_layout): Shop product anchor or LIVE Event anchor.
en._comment_liveShopping: PLACEHOLDER: a 'LIVE shopping' label on a normal VIDEO page has NOT been captured on a device yet. Best effort. LIVE-shopping PREVIEWS in the feed use feed.liveShoppingText below.
en._comment_livePreview: In-feed LIVE preview (captured 47.7.3, k_feed_live_preview, 2026-11-23): a For You pager page that plays a LIVE stream. Same id/viewpager pager as videos; the page's long_press_layout has content-desc 'LIVE' (videos: 'Video'); 'Tap to watch LIVE' and 'LIVE now' texts; the streamer's name is the clickable tv_live_nickname Button. No right rail (avatar/like/share), no caption, no sound. Tapping the preview OR the nickname ENTERS the LIVE room (joining is visible to the streamer), so the parser never exposes an avatar/name node for it; only the pager scroll is safe. Chat/gift lines change every frame and never feed the page signature. The pre-loaded next page ('Video', zero height) is ignored as usual.

feed.liveVideo.note: Clickable: a tap enters the LIVE room. Never tap it.
Clickable: a tap enters the LIVE room. Never tap it.

feed.liveNickname.note: Streamer display name. Clickable: a tap enters the LIVE room. Read the text only.
Name button right under 'LIVE now'. Read the text only.

en._comment_liveShoppingText: PLACEHOLDERS - a LIVE-shopping preview was SEEN on screen on 2026-11-23 but NOT dumped: an auction card reading 'LIVE auction  $1  <buyer> won!', '#405 <product title> 11.23(JZ)', '$14.88 overseas shipping · Final sale', 'Awaiting next item', with a close x. Plain-text matches, searched ONLY among the visible LIVE preview page's nodes (never the top tabs: the 'Shop' tab is a content-desc on every page and is never searched). The streamer's name is excluded. Chat lines may also be on the page, so '$5' or 'sold' in chat can false-positive until a real dump shows the card's structure. Re-check against a dump, then drop 'unverified'.

feed.liveShoppingText.note: Seen next to the shipping price.
Expected on fixed-price items ('12 sold'); not seen yet.
Expected button; not seen yet. Whole-text match, so chat like 'buy me a coffee' does not count.

profile.share.note: clickable=false in 47.7.3; gesture-tap the center and verify the sheet appeared. Case-sensitive on purpose: the 47.9.3 product sheet over a Shop profile has its own lowercase 'share' icon, which must never match.

en._comment_sheet: Profile share sheet ('Send to'). Never read or log the recent-contacts row.
en._comment_dismissibleSheet: Any other modal 'Bottom sheet' in the TOPMOST window with a clickable outside-touch scrim -> DismissibleSheet (captured 47.9.3, n_profile_product_popup, 2026-11-25: tapping a Shop advertiser's avatar opened their profile with a PRODUCT sheet on top: store name + 'OFFICIAL SHOP', lowercase icon descs 'share' / 'cart' / 'more', product title, quantity options, and an 'Add to cart ' / 'Buy now' bar that sits NEXT TO the 'Bottom sheet' container, under the scrim's parent). The scrim's parent is the sheet's scope. The scrim is the only node handed out; nothing inside the sheet is ever tapped. Known sheets (Not interested / Block / Send to) are matched before this.

sheet.dismissScrim.note: Material BottomSheetDialog outside-touch scrim (library ID, not obfuscated; also on the 47.7.3 share sheet and long-press menu). ACTION_CLICK cancels the sheet, like a tap above it.

sheet.commerce.note: Lowercase cart icon in the product sheet header (47.9.3).

en._comment_dialog: Block confirmation dialog (separate window). Title: 'Block <Display Name> (<handle>)?'.
en._comment_verify: Profile after a block: 'Unblock' replaces Follow/Message and 'You blocked <handle>' appears.
en._comment_longpress: Long-press menu on a feed video (captured 47.7.3, j_longpress_menu): a 'Bottom sheet' whose option row holds Buttons with the label as content-desc (About this ad / Report / Not interested / Playback speed). Below it is a contacts list with Send buttons: never read, log, or keep it. Option labels come from the 'Not interested' button's own row only.
en._comment_longpress_placeholders: PLACEHOLDERS - NOT YET CAPTURED ON DEVICE: the reason picker (if TikTok asks why) and the confirmation shown after tapping 'Not interested'. Verify on a device before relying on them.

longpress.reasonTitle.textRegex: (?i)^(tell us why|why are you not interested|select a reason)

verify.notInterested.textRegex: (?i)(we[’']ll show you fewer|thanks for (your )?feedback|less content like this|fewer videos like this)
